text_block_list.text:
I rush Ines Fujin to the infirmary as<n>she's suffered
an injury during<n>training.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I kind of messed up there.<n>Guess I won't be
making my shift<n>today...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But I really don't want to skip out on<n>training...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, um, I think I can grit my teeth<n>through the pain,
so can we have<n>just a light training session?
choice_data_list: Okay, let's do what we can.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I guess that's for the best. It'd<n>be a real
problem if this injury got<n>any worse...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I get it. I'll rest up today so I<n>can recover as
soon as possible...
Disappointed, Ines Fujin returns to<n>her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! All right, let's get in as much<n>training as
we can handle!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I barely even put any weight on<n>it and it's
killing me...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We just started training, and I'm<n>already done...
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's best if you keep the moving to a
minimum.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, maybe... Okay, I'll just take it<n>easy today.
Frustrated, Ines Fujin returns to her<n>dorm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Phew. I think I can handle this level of<n>exercise.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If I keep this up until my injury heals,<n>I won't have
to worry about getting<n>rusty. What a relief!

While monitoring her injury, Ines<n>Fujin completes a
light training<n>session.
